coder_notes: Single-arm integrated regimen (TRPP): continuous low-dose temozolomide 50 mg/m2 daily until progression (not the standard schedule, so coded established_therapy_experiment), radiotherapy, pembrolizumab, and an agent called PF. Pembrolizumab is registered only in the TMZ intervention description (other names: PD-1, RF). PF is not identified in the record (not guessed). Early Phase 1 registration. 11C-MET PET mentioned only for response assessment, not listed.
